test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is, **'Rura**l'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Rural means areas that are opposite of (big) cities that focus on agriculture and farming**.**
 
• Common synonyms for rural areas are villages and countryside.
 
• The correct sentence would be, **Rural areas are also known as the 'countryside' and a 'village' in India**
